name: misc_io_tpuv1
display_name: Miscellaneous I/O and pads beside the interface PHYs (TPUv1, 28 nm)

area.citation: jouppi2017indatacenter Fig. 2 p.3 ('Misc. I/O 1%'); jouppi2021ten Table 1 p.2 (TPUv1 die < 330 mm2, 28 nm)
area.derivation: The TPUv1 floor plan's miscellaneous I/O block is 1% of a die below 330 mm2: 3.3 mm2; band 0.5% to 1.5% (whole percents printed): 1.65 to 4.95 mm2, upper bounds at 28 nm. It is the I/O beside the PCIe and DRAM interfaces, whose own pads are inside their blocks.
